notes:
Inbound SMB lead from marketing form. Primary contact: Maya R. (CTO). Use-case: augment help center search with embeddings + lightweight chat for returns flow. Latency target ~<200ms token responses for chat, embeddings <100ms for single-vector queries. Volume modest: 500k tokens/mo projected during POC, cost sensitive. They prefer public cloud (no VPC) and want quick self-serve onboarding.

Security asks: SOC2 report, DPA + standard data processing terms, and a full list of sub-processors (legal will not sign DPA until they see it). Also asked about audit logging retention and KMS options — but for SMB they said 'KMS later, for POC just need SOC2 and DPA'. Fragments from call: 'We need to show compliance to our merchants', 'who are your sub-processors and where is data stored?'

Sales notes: good technical fit for Hosted API. Recommend tight docs: one-pager SOC2 highlights + explicit sub-processor list + DPA draft. Pricing ask: flat monthly cap for POC to avoid runaway costs. Priya (SE) to run security session and provide config notes for low-cost embeddings (quantized models suggestions from Optimize).

POC ask: 2-week trial, sample dataset (anonymized), goal: 80% reduction in average handle time for support tickets. Legal: wants retention controls spelled out and option to delete customer data on request.

Next actions: send SOC2 one-pager (done 2026-02-18), attach DPA draft (done), confirm sub-processor list (action: product ops to provide), schedule security call wk of 2026-02-24 (Priya leads).
